main_text.l: doctus non adeò magni est momenti, ut
dis diutius immorari sit necesse: Nam sive
citiùs sive seriùs Photino successerit Ire-
parùm aut nihil refert, cùm aliunde sup-
Scriptores, in quibus cernere est Episco-
Ergo absque ullo Causæ Dalliæanæ detri-
mento, testimonio à Blondello in eum fi-
tim cùm ipse Irenæus de quo hoc in loco
tur. Vt igitur paucis rem expediam, ob-
rum pleríque sive Chronographi sive Hi-
storicij. Fateor non sibi constare Eufe-
bium; nam in Historiâ post Chronicum

page.notes: The marginal notes read "Euseb.", "lib. 5. ini." and "tio." (the last two probably "lib. 5. init." and "tio." cut at the margin); the first note is uncertain, so it is only approximate. The word "Eufe-bium" is hyphenated as printed; the note position is approximate. Long s is copied as plain s. The page has no catchword or signature. The Google watermark at the bottom right is left out.
